fusions.name: Skyfall Slam
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and land with your full mass, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipping Note
fusions.desc: Sends a note of song that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles for 60% of the damage each. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Ocean-Wide Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 10 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Landing Weight
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
